artworks.label: Paper Fox
artworks.subject: an alert seated fox beautifully sculpted from many layered amber parchment paper folds, long flowing folded tail curled to one side and pointed ears, standing on a closed unmarked antique book. Tiny curled paper shavings at its feet. Warm amber library light, tactile weathered paper fibers, dimensional miniature craft still life on a softly textured parchment background
